title: The passive: the rule and the simple tenses
intro: Read this before the questions on the passive. The object of the active sentence becomes the subject, and the doer, if it is mentioned, moves to the end with by.

blocks.title: the rule
items: **Active:** doer + verb + object: The chef **cooked** the meal.
**Passive:** object + **be** + **past participle**: The meal **was cooked** by the chef.
**The tense does not change.** Be carries the tense of the active verb, and the main verb becomes a past participle.
**Use the passive** when the doer is unknown, unimportant or obvious, or when the action or its result matters more: My bike **was stolen**. English **is spoken** here.

blocks.title: present simple passive
items: **Form:** am / is / are + past participle: Cars **are made** here. I **am paid** on Fridays.
**Negative and question:** English **isn't spoken** here. **Is** English **spoken** here?

blocks.title: past simple passive
items: **Form:** was / were + past participle: The window **was broken**. The keys **were found**.
**Negative and question:** The keys **weren't found**. **Were** the keys **found**?

blocks.title: future passive
items: **will + be + past participle:** The result **will be announced** tomorrow. (Active: They will announce the result.)
**be going to + be + past participle:** The bridge **is going to be repaired**.
**Negative and question:** It **won't be announced**. **Will** it **be announced**?

blocks.title: the slips
items: **be agrees with the NEW subject:** The keys **were** found (not *The keys was found*).
Use the **past participle**, not the base form or the past form: *The cake was eat* and *The cake was ate* are wrong. Say **eaten**.
Never add do / did: *The window did broken* is wrong.
Irregular participles: make, **made**; write, **written**; steal, **stolen**; break, **broken**; build, **built**; sell, **sold**; take, **taken**; see, **seen**.
